title: change-proposal-tokens-dryrun-safe-apply-retry-protocol-for-optimize
creator: Arjun Menon
description: Implement a robust API + SDK pattern to support Optimize automation where backend recommendations for batching/caching are applied safely via idempotent operations. This ticket defines the proposal-token and dry-run primitives, an apply/retry protocol that supports at-least-once webhook delivery and client retries, and an explicit rollback (undo) flow. The goal is to provide a simple SDK surface for customers and internal services to reliably accept and reconcile Optimize suggestions while preserving traceability, audit logs, and safe rollback semantics.
acceptance_criteria: API exposes POST /optimize/proposals to create a proposal and return a proposal_token and dry_run preview
API exposes POST /optimize/apply with proposal_token or op_idempotency_key to commit changes atomically and return operation_status
Apply operation is idempotent: repeated apply requests with the same op_idempotency_key do not double-apply and return the same final status
Rollback endpoint POST /optimize/undo accepts undo_token or op_idempotency_key and reverses the applied config; produces audit entry
Webhooks include delivery_id and retry headers; server stores webhook-receipt idempotency markers and safely deduplicates deliveries
SDK implements Proposal.create(), Proposal.preview(), Apply.commit(idempotencyKey), Apply.status(opId), and Apply.undo(opId) primitives with clear retry semantics
All applied changes generate a human-readable audit record with operator, proposal_token, op_idempotency_key, and timestamp
Integration tests simulate duplicate webhooks, gateway retries, and concurrent apply attempts; system remains convergent
implementation_notes: Proposal flow: caller POSTs workload snapshot + candidate batching/caching recs -> server returns proposal_token (short-lived UUID) and preview diff. Proposal is immutable once issued.

Apply flow: client calls POST /optimize/apply with proposal_token OR payload + op_idempotency_key; server verifies proposal validity, reserves a lease, applies changes via transactional control plane operations and emits commit event

Idempotency model: op_idempotency_key is user-provided opaque string (recommended UUIDv4). Server persists a single Operation record keyed by (customer_id, op_idempotency_key) and stores final result to return on duplicates.
Dry-run: createProposal with dry_run=true must produce identical verification steps as apply except no write; used by SDK to show potential regressions and unit-cost delta
Rollback: on successful apply server returns undo_token tied to operation. Undo is also idempotent and recorded as a linked operation. Rollback must be reversible and produce cost/latency estimates
Webhooks: include X-Optimize-Delivery: <delivery_id> and X-Optimize-Retry: <int>. Handlers must ack and we persist delivery tombstones for 7 days to dedupe
Retries & backoff: SDK implements exponential backoff with jitter. Server returns 409 when operation currently leasing and 202 when queued
Observability: every step emits trace/span and writes to console-operations log; link operations to rollout dashboards for per-route cost impact

decisions: Use op_idempotency_key pattern rather than only server-generated tokens for easier client retries and reconciliation
Proposal tokens are immutable and short-lived (default 24h); undo_tokens are tied to an operation and recorded for audit
Persist webhook delivery tombstone for 7 days to deduplicate at-least-once delivery across retries
risks: Race between concurrent apply attempts could cause temporary lease conflicts; mitigation: single-writer lease and 409 semantics
Rollback semantics might not fully revert side-effects on third-party systems (customers using private infra); require gating and preflight checks
Long proposal lifetimes increase surface for stale suggestions and drift versus actual runtime; default 24h aims to limit this
notes_for_QA: Create simulated customer with idempotency_key reuse and validate no duplicate config applies
Simulate webhook duplicate deliveries and confirm tombstone dedupe path
Validate undo_token always reverts to previous config and emits audit entry
